disposition_reason: Cadmium in soft tissue of mussels, oysters, razor clams, cockles and clams from Dakhla Bay production areas, 2012-2020, with site means printed in ANOVA reports.

study.design: official semiannual monitoring of cadmium in bivalves from shellfish production areas
study.origin: natural beds and farms in Dakhla Bay, Morocco
study.method: pressure digestion per NM EN 13805:2015; Cd by ICP-MS (Thermo iCAP-Q) per NM EN 15763:2012
study.qa: blanks and high-purity acids; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Per-season values appear only in Figures 2-4 (bar charts); not read.

Text says the maximum (1.55 mg/kg, oysters, winter 2018) does not exceed national thresholds, yet Circular 1508-12 is given as 1 mg/kg; the paper also says oysters exceeded the European threshold from late 2017 to winter 2018.
The paper cites Regulation (EC) 854/2004 as setting a 1 mg/kg threshold; that regulation concerns official controls, not maximum levels.
